source: Pew Research Center. American Trends Panel Wave 114, fielded September 13-18, 2022.
method: Population is respondent's self-reported religious affiliation (F_RELIG) - Wave 114 does not carry the finer F_RELTRAD frame variable used in other ATP waves in this dataset family. Share saying it is "essential" to what being a faithful member of their tradition means to them that they believe in God (ESSENT_a_W114). Refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT_W114 variable.
